note: Shortcode Basic Tags ships ten @Shortcode plugins (ids = tokens): block, button, clear, dropcap, highlight, img, item, link, quote, random. No config UI, no permissions, no services of its own. Every tag still requires the parent module's `shortcode` filter to be enabled on a text format, plus that specific shortcode id set to true in filter.format.<format>.filters.shortcode.settings, before its [tag] markup is parsed instead of shown literally. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on namespaced `sbt_*` text formats.

evals.prompt: The Drupal submodule shortcode_basic_tags ships a `[quote]` shortcode. What HTML element does it wrap the text in, and name one optional attribute it accepts that lets you attribute the quote to someone.
evals.expected_output: [quote] renders as a <span class="quote"> (via the shortcode_quote theme hook / shortcode-quote.html.twig). The optional `author` attribute prepends "<author> wrote:" before the text; `class` adds extra CSS classes.

evals.prompt: The `[button]` shortcode in shortcode_basic_tags builds a link styled as a button. What attribute specifies the link target, and what does it default to if you don't set it?
evals.expected_output: The `path` attribute sets the link target (an internal path or `url` for an absolute URL); if omitted it defaults to `<front>`, the site's front page.

evals.prompt: The `[block]` shortcode in shortcode_basic_tags lets you embed a custom block instance inline in body text. What attribute identifies which block to render, and what kind of value does it expect?
evals.expected_output: The `id` attribute holds the numeric block_content entity id (loaded via BlockContent::load()); an optional `view` attribute picks the view mode, defaulting to `full`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there's a text format called `sbt_eval`. It has the `shortcode` filter enabled with shortcode_basic_tags tags configured. Inspect the live config and tell me the numeric weight of the shortcode filter within this format's filter pipeline.
evals.expected_output: The shortcode filter's weight on sbt_eval is 17 (filter.format.sbt_eval.filters.shortcode.weight: 17).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the text format `sbt_toggle` has the shortcode filter enabled with the `quote` and `highlight` tags configured — exactly one of them is turned on. Inspect the live config and tell me which one (quote or highlight) is enabled.
evals.expected_output: quote is enabled: filter.format.sbt_toggle.filters.shortcode.settings.quote is true, while settings.highlight is false.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the text format `sbt_task` exists but has no shortcode filter configured at all. Enable the shortcode filter on this format AND make sure the `quote` shortcode from shortcode_basic_tags is turned on, so `[quote]...[/quote]` renders. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: filter.format.sbt_task.filters.shortcode.status is true and filters.shortcode.settings.quote is true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the text format `sbt_task2` has the shortcode filter enabled, but the `img` shortcode from shortcode_basic_tags is turned off within it. Enable the img shortcode on this format so `[img src="..."]` renders an image. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: filter.format.sbt_task2.filters.shortcode.settings.img is set to true while the shortcode filter itself remains enabled (status true).
